editorial:
Imagine moving into a new neighborhood only to find out the people living there are hateful and bigoted. That is exactly what happens to a scientist and his family in this wild ride from 1977. Since the family is being targeted, the father uses his genius to create a special elixir that grants superhuman strength and speed. He gives this power to their tough bodyguard, Abar, turning him into a powerhouse who can fly and take down criminals. It feels like a comic book come to life, mixing social issues with old-school action and a very cool superhero vibe.

You will love how Abar uses his powers to protect the innocent, though the pacing can be a bit slow in some spots. The acting is campy but fun, and the stunts are exactly what you expect from a movie made decades ago. If you are into retro cinema or early superhero stories, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best quality, or just look for it to rent on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Abar uses his super strength to fight off the villains who have been terrorizing the neighborhood. He manages to stop the bad guys in their tracks and proves that strength is best used to protect others. The movie wraps up with the bigots realizing they cannot win against someone like Abar. He becomes a local hero, and the family finally finds some peace knowing they have a super-powered protector on their side.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school superhero movies and retro action.
